parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in the PlaybackTests test target under `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/Behavior/`. Although the Jaccard similarity of 0.714 suggests structural overlap in the test body, the two methods — `PlayerControllerBehaviorTests.multiplePlayCallsAreIdempotent` and `RouteChangeBehaviorTests.overrideWhilePlayingIsHandled` — are testing distinct behavioral scenarios (idempotent play calls vs. route-change override handling) and belong to separate test classes. Shared structure in test helpers is common and intentional; collapsing them risks obscuring the distinct behavioral intent each test encodes.
